name: NGC 4434 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4434, an early-type galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4434-hubble
story: An early-type galaxy, cataloged as elliptical or lenticular, among the crowds of the Virgo Cluster. Hubble imaged it as one of 100 early-type galaxies in the ACS Virgo Cluster Survey.

claims.text: VCC 1025 is NGC 4434, an E0/S0 early-type galaxy in the Virgo Cluster
The ACS Virgo Cluster Survey imaged 100 early-type galaxies in the Virgo Cluster
